name: Amalgum
look: three fused molars with sad faces, the two in front and a taller one behind, capped in dripping steel with grey amalgam fillings, on pink roots tipped with metal points
entry: Three Cavitot that had their cavities filled and fused into one. The metal in their fillings makes it tough to crack, but all three of its faces still frown. It gnaws on iron ore to keep its caps shiny.
how: Wild: uncommon in Dripstone Caves, rare in the Deep Dark.
